struct Edge {
    int u, v, cap, rev;
    Edge(int uu, int vv, int cc, int rr) : u(uu), v(vv), cap(cc), rev(rr) {}
};

vector<Edge> edgeList;
vector<vector<int>> adjList;

int maxFlow(int src, int dst) {
    int total = 0;
    while (true) {
        vector<int> parent(edgeList.size(), -1);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(src);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int i = 0; i < adjList[u].size(); ++i) {
                int e = adjList[u][i];
                int v = edgeList[e].v;
                if (edgeList[e].cap == 0 || parent[v] >= 0) continue;
                q.push(v);
                parent[v] = e;
            }
        }
        if (parent[dst] < 0) break;
        int bottleneck = INT_MAX;
        for (int x = dst; x != src; x = edgeList[parent[x]].u)
            bottleneck = min(bottleneck, edgeList[parent[x]].cap);
        for (int x = dst; x != src; x = edgeList[parent[x]].u) {
            edgeList[parent[x]].cap -= bottleneck;
            edgeList[edgeList[parent[x]].rev].cap += bottleneck;
        }
        total += bottleneck;
    }
    return total;
}

void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, bool directed = true) {
    edgeList.emplace_back(u, v, cap, edgeList.size() + 1);
    adjList[u].push_back(edgeList.size() - 1);
    edgeList.emplace_back(v, u, directed ? 0 : cap, edgeList.size() - 2);
    adjList[v].push_back(edgeList.size() - 1);
}

const int MAX_SIZE = 11;
int n, t;
char state[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
const int dRow[4] = {1, -1, 0, 0};
const int dCol[4] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

void propagateZ() {
    for (int step = 0; step < t; ++step) {
        for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x)
            for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y)
                strcpy(state[x][y] + step + 1, state[x][y] + step);
        for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                if (state[x][y][step] == 'Z') {
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int nx = x + dRow[k], ny = y + dCol[k];
                        if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && state[nx][ny][step] != 'Y')
                            state[nx][ny][step + 1] = 'Z';
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

struct BFSNode {
    int x, y, depth;
    BFSNode(int a, int b, int d) : x(a), y(b), depth(d) {}
};

bool visited[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];

int encode(int x, int y, int size) { return x * size + y; }
int inputNode(int u) { return u + n * n; }
int outputNode(int u) { return u; }

void bfsExplore(int sx, int sy) {
    memset(visited, 0, sizeof(visited));
    queue<BFSNode> q;
    q.emplace(sx, sy, 0);
    visited[sx][sy][0] = true;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        BFSNode cur = q.front(); q.pop();
        if (cur.depth > t) continue;
        if (isdigit(state[cur.x][cur.y][0])) {
            addEdge(encode(sx, sy, n), inputNode(encode(cur.x, cur.y, n)), state[sx][sy][0] - '0', false);
        }
        if (state[cur.x][cur.y][cur.depth] == 'Z') continue;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            int nx = cur.x + dRow[k], ny = cur.y + dCol[k];
            if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && state[nx][ny][cur.depth] != 'Y' && state[nx][ny][cur.depth] != 'Z' && !visited[nx][ny][cur.depth]) {
                visited[nx][ny][cur.depth] = true;
                q.emplace(nx, ny, cur.depth + 1);
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n >> t;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            cin >> state[i][j][0];
    
    propagateZ();
    
    int source = 3 * n * n;
    int sink = source + 1;
    edgeList.clear();
    adjList.assign(5 * n * n, vector<int>());
    
    char room[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            cin >> room[i][j];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (isdigit(room[i][j]) && room[i][j] != '0') {
                addEdge(inputNode(encode(i, j, n)), inputNode(inputNode(encode(i, j, n))), room[i][j] - '0', false);
                addEdge(inputNode(inputNode(encode(i, j, n))), sink, 1 << 30, false);
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (isdigit(state[i][j][0]) && state[i][j][0] != '0') {
                bfsExplore(i, j);
                addEdge(source, encode(i, j, n), state[i][j][0] - '0', false);
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << maxFlow(source, sink) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
